1. In your current approach, how might the explicit marking of quantifier scope help reveal whether a potential fallacy stems from misinterpreting the original natural language phrasing rather than the underlying logical structure?

2. Considering your focus on minimal counterexamples and boundary cases, what criteria would you use to determine when constructing such counterexamples becomes unnecessary—and could this efficiency inadvertently mask certain types of negation-related formal fallacies?
